document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Make a Dodge roll to avoid the monsters, followed by a Climb 
roll. If you succeed, you escape and go to 399. If you fail, 
the mummies grab at you, pulling at your skin. You hear the 
horrifying sound of your own flesh tearing. The last thing you 
see is an open mouth leering down at you, as you scream for 
blessed unconsciousness. It is … THE END.
(431)
